entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I ordered a jersey a while back and it just doesn't fit. I'm not really sure what to do, the website was a little confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, can you please provide me with your order number?
Thank you. I see the order for the Pro-Series Aero Jersey. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just the wrong size. I thought I ordered a Large but it feels... well, it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I'm not sure if I read the size chart wrong.
I understand. So you'd like to do an exchange for a different size?
Yes, I think so. Can I do that? I've had it for a little while. I'm so sorry, I just got overwhelmed and didn't know how the process worked. Can't you just help me?
Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me just check the delivery date... Okay, I see it was delivered 51 days ago. That's not a problem at all.
Oh, it's not? I was worried I waited too long.

Not at all. For standard items like this jersey, VeloFit has a 90-day return and exchange policy. You are well within that window. I've just initiated the exchange process for you. I'm sending an email right now with a pre-paid return label. You'll just need to print it, put the original jersey in a box, and drop it off.
Oh, wow! That's... that's so much easier than I thought it would be. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've really helped me out.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Have a great day and thank you for calling VeloFit.
